R8 INDEPENDENT MOVE GENERATOR + STATE-KEY ENCODER DELIVERED. File: src/vb_movegen.zig. Standalone (imports only std; no src/ imports, per spec R8). Implements legalMoves(state) -> [moves_bytes]u8 (SMD1 §4.6.3 bitmap: bit i = cell i legal, bit n = pass legal) and stateKey(state) -> StateKey (mirrors src/rules.zig StateKey struct interface — colex_idx:u64, side:u1 [0=Black,1=White], ko:u16, passes:u2, terminal:bool). Co-implements posFromColex / colexFromPos for D1.

== (1) OUTPUT CONTRACTS ==

legalMoves bitmap: SMD1-compliant. moves_bytes(w,h) = ceil((w*h+1)/8). For 2x2 = 1B, 3x2 = 1B, 3x3 = 2B, 4x4 = 3B. Bit ordering: bit 0 = LSB of byte 0; pass is bit (w*h). Bits > n+1 are zero (SMD1 §4.6.3 requires this).

stateKey: 1:1 with the kernel's StateKey struct. Side encoding: +1 (Black) -> 0, -1 (White) -> 1. Ko: stored as raw u8 widened to u16 (the SMD1 artifact-slice uses 255 for NONE; the kernel's in-memory NONE is n = w*h; both values read as NONE in legalMoves since ko_set = (ko < n)). terminal: passes == 2.

== (2) MOVE-LEGALITY PREDICATE ==

A state s = (pos, side, ko, passes). s.passes == 2 → empty bitmap (C1 absorbing terminal). Otherwise for each empty cell c, in order: skip if ko_set and c == s.ko (B1 recapture forbidden); skip if placement at c is suicide (A4 — A3 capture first, then check the placed-stone group has >=1 liberty, derived from AXIOMS §2 A3+A4 by direct flood-fill, not translated from rules.zig); else set bit c. Always set the pass bit (A5/B3 — pass is always legal, clears ko).

Suicide is computed by:
  1. Copy pos to next with signs normalized to {-1, 0, +1}.
  2. next[c] = side.
  3. For each opponent neighbour of c: if its chain has no liberty, remove it.
  4. Check the placed-stone group has at least one liberty (flood-fill).

== (3) TEST BAR ==

zig test src/vb_movegen.zig: 19/19 pass. Wiring proof completed: (a) clean run green; (b) seeded `try expect(false)` makes the suite red (1 fail, 19 pass); (c) removing it makes the suite green again. All tests live in src/vb_movegen.zig (build.zig not edited; sprint console owns that wire-in).

Tests cover:
  - colex bijection round-trip on all 81 positions of 2x2; empty board is index 0; 3x3 total = 19,683.
  - legalMoves: empty 2x2 (5 bits set), full 2x2 (only pass), suicide corner (2x2 with pos {0,-1,-1,0}, side Black — both 0 and 3 are suicide; only pass legal), ko point forbids recapture, terminal (passes=2) has no moves, side inversion (White to move), 3x2 empty board, moves_bytes for 3x2 and 4x4.
  - stateKey: empty 2x2 root (colex 0, side 0, ko n, passes 0, terminal false), side encoding Black->0/White->1, terminal iff passes==2, ko stored as raw (both n and 255 read as NONE in legalMoves via ko < n), 1-stone colex_idx (Black at cell 0 = 2, White at cell 0 = 1 — matches colex.zig's expected values for the 1-stone layer), distinct positions yield distinct keys, same state tuple yields same key.

== (4) DELIBERATE BLINDNESS — WHAT WAS NOT READ ==

Per the brief, the implementation was written from AXIOMS.md §2 (A1–A6, B1–B3 prose + claim IDs) and the SMD1 §4.6.3 record format. The StateKey struct interface (field names + types, no implementation) was copied from src/rules.zig. The pos_from_move / koAfterCapture / apply_place32 code paths in src/rules.zig and src/exp6_solve.zig were NOT read; the suicide/ko logic was derived directly from the AXIOMS prose. The colex bijection was re-derived from the layered formula in src/colex.zig's header comment (project-public knowledge: layered by stone count, combinatorial number system for subset, colour bit j = j-th occupied cell ascending, 1 = black).

Wave 1 scheduling (per plan.md §8) means MG-KERN (T339) has not run yet at the time of writing — the kernel function being checked does not exist when R8 ships, which is the structural enforcement of the blindness rule (not trust). The comparison against the kernel is KEY-4x4 / I11's job, not this row's.

== (5) KNOWN MINOR DESIGN CHOICES (for the comparison rows) ==

- The SMD1 record's `side` field is encoded as 1=Black, 2=White; my StateKey.side (matching the kernel) is 0=Black, 1=White. The I11 reader will need to translate 1->+1, 2->-1 BEFORE constructing the State input. This is a reader-side concern, not a vb_movegen concern.
- The SMD1 artifact-slice uses ko=255 (NONE); my legalMoves accepts any ko >= n as NONE. The comparison reading should call legalMoves with ko=255 (or any sentinel >= n) and get the same result as a 4x4 reading with ko=16. Both work.
- terminal bit is set iff passes == 2 — the kernel's convention (matches StateKey.terminal = (passes == 2) in src/rules.zig:1078).
- legalMoves at passes == 2 returns an empty bitmap (no children, including no pass). At passes == 0 or 1, the pass bit is set. The SMD1 artifact-slice only dumps the passes=0, ko=NONE slice — for the I11 comparison on that slice, this is a non-issue (no terminal entries at that slice).
